critical_code_review_comments: Background-task exception handlers in routes/registration.py and routes/crm.py still swallow ALL exceptions and only log. Consider letting NameError/ImportError re-raise (or fail the API call) so future refactors don't silently break side effects again. The current iter7 -> iter8 bug pattern (registration returns 200 but no badge PNG sent) would have been caught immediately if these helper errors surfaced.

Recommend a startup-time import sanity check: load each routes/* module on app boot and exercise the helper paths via a smoke test, since most helpers are only triggered by user actions (registration, resend, reminder).
